_about: How the geography lens places a footprint. location_types are the assets that record a postal location; country_field and city_field name their fields. Its own locations are those of the controlled assets (the organization's addresses, the contacts of its registrations). Where it is hosted comes from the network lens: each hosting party's own stored location, weighted by the names it hosts; when the party has none, the first of party_location_paths that reaches a location with a country (each step a direction and a relation label, such as the contact records naming an organization, or a network registration's registrant) supplies it. Registration addresses say where a party is registered, not where its servers run. Add values here, not in Go code.
